title: Profile photo upload fails with generic error for PNG files
body:
## Description
During a recorded session in ProfileHub, the user encountered: Profile photo upload fails with generic error for PNG files.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Observe UI state: Edit profile
2. Observe UI state: avatar.png
3. Observe UI state: Upload failed

## Expected Behavior
The application should complete the user flow without errors.

## Actual Behavior
The session shows failure indicators including: Upload failed.

## Environment
- App: ProfileHub
- Platform: web
